ارتشين (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَيْنَ (irtašayna) /ir.ta.ʃaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اُرْتُشِينَ (urtušīna) /ur.tu.ʃiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اِرْتَشِينَ (irtašīna) /ir.ta.ʃiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
